tools.name: list_coverage
tools.description: List the states CompBasis covers (with whether each is live, and its caveats), the call limits for keyless and keyed use, and whether a new analysis can start now. Useful when an address is rejected as out of scope or a limit is reached.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: analyze_property · Private data: analyze_property, ask_about_property, lookup · Public sink: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Destructive: analyze_property, lookup.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: analyze_property · Private data: analyze_property, ask_about_property, lookup · Public sink: analyze_property, ask_about_property · Destructive: analyze_property, lookup

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "get_report" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
